thread:
ops-bot: ALERT: billing anomaly detected — token_count delta > 15% vs baseline (00:30 window). source=metering-emitter-prod-eu1. pager -> @lisa-oncall :rotating_light:

samir: Picking this up, oncall here. @maria can you grab a quick recon on emitter logs and shadow vs live ledger?

maria: pulling now. initial snapshot: shadow_ledger - live_ledger = +18% for acme-* cluster. Running quick SQL and log grep.

kyle: fyi we had a canary rollout ~8054321600 (emitter v2.4) in eu1, small % traffic. Could be related.

samir: don't rollback yet — confirm duplication vs ingest issue. maria, grep for duplicate request ids and seq numbers.

maria: running:```sh
# find duplicate request ids in last 10m
grep "request_id" /var/log/emitter/*.log | awk -F"request_id=" '{print $2}' | cut -d' ' -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head
```

maria: sample from output: `2 request_id=abc123 seq=42` — same request observed twice within 30s. pattern = retries + ack not observed. looks like batching-plugin ack race.

eng-anna: I can patch or flip the flag. Recommend disabling new-batching plugin until root cause fixed. I can hit the control plane to flip.

samir: good. eng-anna, please disable plugin; kyle prepare rollback if needed. Also add temporary throttle to emitter to reduce token bleed: `redwoodctl throttle set emitter-eu1 100rps`

eng-anna: disabling plugin flag now (api -> POST /config/emitter/plugin/batching "enabled":false) ... response 200.

kyle: starting rollback to v2.3 canary -> full for eu1 (deploy id deploy-8054321799). ETA ~6m. I'll monitor. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT: rollback job started by kyle at 8054321805.

support-jen: support triage — which customers hit overage flags? pulling metering-report. preliminary list: acme-inc, beta-co, luminous.ai (all eu1). I'm drafting customer note.

kyle: rollback complete at 8054322100. rolling metrics now.

maria: re-run the duplicate search post-rollback. result: no repeat request_ids in last 5m, delta down to ~1.6%. sample check: `shadow - live = 1.6%`

samir: nice. keep watching for 30m. Jen, please hold off external messaging until we confirm sustained drop, but prepare the note. suggested blurb: "We detected a metering discrepancy affecting usage reports in EU region; corrective action in progress; we'll reconcile charges and follow up."

support-jen: copying suggested blurb. will queue and send once samir confirms. I'll open billing ticket for the three affected customers and tag finance.

maria: monitoring dashboards — ingestion ack rates normalized, token emission graph returning to baseline. no new duplicates.

eng-anna: root cause summary for postmortem: batching plugin introduced a race between ack handling and retry backoff on canary; caused duplicate emits under specific sequence timing. mitigation = disable plugin, immediate rollback, add idempotency guard and circuit-breaker, add test for duplicate suppression.

samir: action items: 1) eng-anna owner for fix + PR (label: incident/8054321987) 2) update runbook with new checklist to flip plugin flags 3) support-jen to send reconciliations and billing tickets 4) ops to monitor for 3h and close. I'll move to mitigated if stable.

support-jen: acknowledged. drafting customer messages & billing tickets now.

ops-bot: INCIDENT: status -> mitigated at 8054322399 by samir. :white_check_mark: 

samir: great work team. follow-up: please start a short postmortem doc with timeline + diffs, include the grep output and deploy IDs. assign reviewers: kyle, eng-anna, maria, support-jen.

kyle: will add deploy timeline and rollback logs. :thumbsup:

maria: uploading the grep excerpts and graphs to the incident doc now.

support-jen: I'll coordinate customer comms and refunds once the postmortem is up.

lisa-oncall: thanks all — handing back to normal ops.
